component.name: autoBack
component.summary: System snapshot & restore with an integrated independent rescue system

description.p: autoBack protects your system by taking btrfs snapshots that automatically carry a consistent GRUB/ESP archive, so the bootloader travels together with the system on every restore.
It also builds and installs an independent rescue system (EFISTUB UKI) directly from the firmware boot entry - capable of restoring the system even when GRUB and the OS itself are broken.
autoBack is a deep fork of Timeshift and is NOT a backup tool for user data; users' home directories are excluded by default.
Initial release: Timeshift deep fork with automatic ESP/GRUB snapshot archives and integrated rescue system installer.
